verdicts.reason: A keeps the arched white panel with cross, headline, verse and address in the right order and readable, and the panel fills the story format well. Flaws: the panel's top arch is cropped tight against the canvas top, and the image looks upscaled and soft. B is broken: all the text has moved off the panel and sits on the busy fresco where it can't be read, the white panel is left empty in the lower middle, and the cross ornament has dropped into the bottom-left corner over the icons.
